The IMPEDANCE knob affects only the TS port of the Combo input regardless of the connected cable.

By default, TS cables connected to RETURN 1/2 will only transmit signal routed to RETURN 1. To access both RETURNS, use an insert cable (TRS to dual TS) to split the signal as follows:

• Tip: RETURN 1
• Ring: RETURN 2

By default, TS cables connected to SEND 1/2 will only transmit signal routed to SEND 1. To access both SENDS, use an insert cable (TRS to dual TS) to split the signal as follows:

• Tip: SEND 1
• Ring: SEND 2

Splitters and Mixers allow you to split your signal chain to route your signal to multiple outputs or add more Virtual Device blocks to The Grid.

If you move any block vertically on The Grid between Rows 1 & 2 or 3 & 4, a Splitter/Mixer path will be created automatically. Dragging a block between Rows 1 or 2 and 3 or 4 will copy the Virtual Device.
The Splitter sets the location where the signal splits.
The Mixer sets the location where the signal joins a Row again.
Detailed parameters are available for Splitters and Mixers that allow for switching between types, shortcut buttons for quick splits, and an on/off toggle.
